findings.message: No box consumer exists in the daemon composition. `squatch/daemon.py` exposes only `compose_daemon_dispatch` and `compose_daemon_rework`. findings.paved_road: Name the box consumer as a concrete awaitable, e.g. an injected `Callable[[], Awaitable[None]]` wrapping one `Triage.run` pass, repeated by the owner. findings.message: The acceptance criterion bundles four behaviors (start, await shutdown, observe cancellation, surface exceptions) across three consumers into one sentence.
